verdict.rationale: pnpm's homepage says its first-class monorepo support includes 'filtering to run tasks on just the projects you touched'. That covers running scripts on a subset of workspace packages, including only changed ones. Community users corroborate that the built-in monorepo support works well as a script runner, but the evidence is a single thin marketing line. missing for 10: documentation of filter syntax and selectors, evidence that installs (not just scripts) can be filtered, documented change-detection (e.g. since a git ref) or dependency/dependent selection, hands-on corroboration of filtering specifically.
